blocks.title: Sort into: Igneous / Sedimentary / Metamorphic
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Igneous, Sedimentary, Metamorphic.
blocks.answer: Igneous: granite; basalt. Sedimentary: sandstone; chalk. Metamorphic: marble; slate

keywords.def: rock made when hot melted rock cools: granite, basalt
rock made from layers pressed together over a long time: sandstone, chalk
rock changed by heat and pressure: marble, slate

questions.q: Write three precise adjectives for your rock
Make a note: Sandstone is made when sand is pressed into layers.
Core: write two sentences describing your rock with precise adjectives
questions.a: For example: My rock is speckled and cold. One edge is jagged like a broken tooth.

questions.q: Extend: complete the notes grid for all three rock types
questions.a: Grid with formation and two examples each

questions.q: Stretch: decide which type your rock might be and give a reason
questions.a: For example: sedimentary, because I can see thin layers

questions.q: Chalk is made from layers pressed together over a long time. It is...
questions.a: B) sedimentary. Layers pressed together make sedimentary rock. Igneous rock comes from cooled lava; metamorphic rock is changed by heat and pressure.
